text:
After a pleasant session, many thanks for your clear note, and we are sorry to hear that your recent journey left you worried about the handling of your companion animal and the service you received from Aurelia Skyways. We understand that this kind of experience can feel personal and upsetting, especially when you expected steady care from booking through pickup.

Your complaint has been reviewed by the Companion Animal Travel Desk, and we are treating it as a service failure rather than a routine delay. Our records show the normal coordination steps were in place, but your report suggests that the handoff did not meet the standard we aim to keep. That is not the outcome we want for any traveler.

We have asked the supervising team to look again at the handling of your case and to check the notes from the desk, the airport support staff, and the receiving side of the journey. Where a concern is raised, we follow a calm stepwise review so that the facts are checked before any final response is given. This approach helps us separate a simple misread from a real service gap and keeps the review fair.

If extra assistance is still needed for your companion animal, we will continue to support you through the proper channels and make sure your concerns are carried forward to the people who can act on them. We also remind the team to give clear updates, since that is often what matters most when a passenger is already under strain. Your feedback has been added to our service review file so the issue can be used in future training and oversight.

We appreciate that trust has to be earned on every trip, and we take that seriously at Aurelia Skyways. Thank you for bringing this to us and for giving us the chance to look into it with care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
